source.title: Epic Armaments of Battle - Honored Amongst the Dawn
source.description:
Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power?

I must warn you; purchases made at honored reputation with the Dawn come with an extremely hefty surcharge. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.
source.objective: For 75 Insignias of the Dawn and 75 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
